hosea.8.p1.b1.text: Put the ram’s horn to your lips! An eagle looms over the house of the LORD, because the people have transgressed My covenant and rebelled against My law.

hosea.8.p1.b2.text: They set up kings, but not by Me. They make princes, but without My approval. …

hosea.8.p1.b3.text: He has rejected your calf, O Samaria. … It will be broken to pieces, that calf of Samaria.

hosea.8.p1.b4.text: For they sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind. There is no standing grain; what sprouts fails to yield flour. …

hosea.8.p1.b5.text: For they have gone up to Assyria like a wild donkey on its own. Ephraim has hired lovers.

hosea.8.p1.b6.text: Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces … But I will send fire upon their cities, and it will consume their citadels.
